objective: Let the quest domain count enemy kills.
criteria: the domain stays engine-free (no Node types)
context: Layering is presentation -> gameplay -> domain -> data; a domain class must run with no scene tree (L-036). Autoload budget is frozen at five (D-017).
diff:
--- a/src/domain/quest/kill_counter.gd
+++ b/src/domain/quest/kill_counter.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+class_name KillCounter
+extends Node
+
+var _counts: Dictionary = {}
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	get_tree().root.get_node("CombatEvents").enemy_killed.connect(_on_kill)
+
+func _on_kill(enemy: CharacterBody2D) -> void:
+	_counts[enemy.enemy_id] = _counts.get(enemy.enemy_id, 0) + 1
